interpretationPolicy.missingFieldPolicy: Missing or undocumented fields remain null/absent and are not interpreted as a pass, failure, causal category, or tool-quality signal.

interpretationPolicy.secondaryPolicy: Each secondary runner document and durable E1/SD schema document is retained as recorded evidence. Directory and file names do not establish a causal category.
interpretationPolicy.excludedCorrectionPolicy: Explicitly listed excluded correction roots are preserved for audit but are not canonical secondary cells, observations, final outcomes, repair counts, or treatment-fidelity results.
